SRB.Settings.Language.Name: Language
SRB.Settings.Language.Hint: Choose whether Roll Breakdown follows Foundry or uses a fixed module language.
SRB.Settings.Enabled.Name: Enable roll breakdowns
SRB.Settings.Enabled.Hint: Add the breakdown panel to eligible chat messages on this client.
SRB.Settings.DefaultExpanded.Name: Expanded by default
SRB.Settings.DefaultExpanded.Hint: Open the breakdown panel automatically for new eligible messages.
SRB.Settings.Visibility.Name: Breakdown visibility
SRB.Settings.Visibility.Hint: Choose who sees the breakdown panel. Owners are players who made the roll or own the speaking actor. GMs always see it.
SRB.Settings.HideNpcRolls.Name: Hide the breakdown of NPC and GM rolls
SRB.Settings.HideNpcRolls.Hint: Players get no panel on rolls from actors that no player owns or on GM rolls without a player owned speaker. This keeps monster bonuses secret.
SRB.Settings.GmRollPrivacy.Name: Hide GM rolls from players
SRB.Settings.GmRollPrivacy.Hint: Players see these GM rolls with their total only, without formula, dice and breakdown. Private GM rolls do not show up for them at all. Rolls of player characters on cards of several actors stay visible.
SRB.Settings.GmRollPublic.Name: Hide formula and dice of GM rolls
SRB.Settings.GmRollPublic.Hint: Players see only the total of a GM roll they can see. Applies when GM rolls are hidden from players.
SRB.Settings.GmRollPrivate.Name: Remove private GM rolls
SRB.Settings.GmRollPrivate.Hint: GM rolls for the GM only, blind rolls and self rolls disappear from the chat of players, instead of the line that the GM rolled privately. Applies when GM rolls are hidden from players.
SRB.Settings.GmRollCrits.Name: Show critical hits and fumbles
SRB.Settings.GmRollCrits.Hint: A GM roll without formula and dice keeps the color of a critical hit or a fumble on its total.
SRB.GmRollPrivacy.All: All GM rolls, also for player characters
SRB.Settings.ShowUnknown.Name: Show unknown terms
SRB.Settings.ShowUnknown.Hint: Display unresolved or unlabeled formula terms instead of hiding them.
SRB.Settings.Debug.Name: Debug logging
SRB.Settings.Debug.Hint: Write roll breakdown decisions and parser details to the browser console.
SRB.SelfTest.Title: Roll Breakdown self test
SRB.SelfTest.Hint: Checks the support for your game system, a test roll, the latest roll in the chat and the panel. Run it after an update of Foundry or the system.
SRB.SelfTest.Passed: Self test passed: {checks} checks, system support {system}.
SRB.SelfTest.Problems: Self test: {problems} of {checks} checks failed. See the chat message.
SRB.SelfTest.NewVersions: Roll Breakdown was verified with older versions than {versions}. Run the self test in the module settings to check that everything still works.
SRB.SelfTest.Texts: The texts of the module are missing.
SRB.SelfTest.Adapter: The support for {system} did not load.
SRB.SelfTest.TestRoll: A test roll could not be broken down.
SRB.SelfTest.LatestRoll: The latest roll in the chat could not be broken down.
SRB.SelfTest.Template: The panel template of the module is missing.
SRB.SelfTest.Stored: A breakdown stored on a chat message could not be read back.
SRB.SelfTest.NoRoll: The chat holds no roll yet, so only the test roll was checked.
SRB.Debug.Title: Debug file
SRB.Debug.Hint: Saves one file for bug reports about all of Sephral’s modules in this world: versions, settings and what the modules recorded, such as the latest chat messages they read. It contains chat text and whispers, check it before you share it.
SRB.Debug.Saved: Debug file {file} saved. It contains chat text and whispers, check it before you share it.
